title: 第十三章 族老苏然第十四章 委托殿
content_zh:
第十三章：族老苏然随着一声轻喝，苏命猛地挥剑。
刹那间，九道金色剑芒相继斩出。
“武技！你怎么可能会武技？”看到这一幕，柳天然面露惊讶之色。
在潜龙城，武技可以说极为珍贵，哪怕是潜龙城四大家族的人，没有达到气海境之前也没有资格接触武技。
苏命废物这么多年，一朝醒悟居然就掌握了武技，这实在是太过匪夷所思。
“你已经没必要知道答案了。”苏命说话之间，剑芒已经斩到了柳天然身前。
“就凭你？”柳天然冷笑一声，一刀劈在剑芒之上，挡住了剑芒的攻击。
但还没来得及喘息，下一刻第二道剑芒已经斩至。
然后，是第三道剑芒……
第四道剑芒……
第五道剑芒……
……
剑芒如大海之中的波浪，一道接着一道朝着柳天然冲击而去。
九道剑芒释放出巨大的剑气威力，柳天然全力抵抗，但下一刻，柳天然刀身之上突然传来一道碎裂的声音。
“咔嚓！”
刀身之上露出一丝裂缝，随后，那裂缝越来越大，长刀在柳天然不敢置信的目光中轰然碎裂
“不！这……这怎么可能！”
长刀崩碎，巨大的冲击力下，柳天然整个人如炮弹一般倒飞出了院门，而后重重砸在了地上。
但苏命却没打算就这么放过柳天然，他身形一闪，整个人持剑来到柳天然身前。
“你……你要干什么？”看着眼前的苏命，柳天然满脸惊恐。

他原本是柳家派来对付苏命的，但没想到，他却连苏命一剑都没接下来。
“干什么？”苏命冷笑连连：“自然是杀你！”
“不……”柳天然疯狂摇头，死亡面前，他终于露出恐惧。
身后，柳媚儿大喊道：“苏命，柳天然乃是我柳家族老，你要是敢杀了他，那就是和我柳家不死不休！”
“呵呵……”听到这话的苏命笑了，露出一口洁白的牙齿，在深夜中泛着冷冽的光芒。
“我不杀他，柳家就会和我一笑泯恩仇了吗？别说这种让大家都觉得搞笑的话了！”
话音落下，苏命的长剑在柳媚儿和柳天然诧异的目光之中，狠狠刺进了柳天然的胸膛。
“噗！”
长剑轻易没入柳天然胸膛，后者瞪大眼睛，似乎临死都不敢相信苏命真的敢对自己下手。
“嗖！”
拔出长剑，苏命甚至都没看一眼身后已经毫无生机的柳天然。
便手持带血长剑，一步步朝着柳媚儿走去。
鲜血顺着长剑流了一地，此刻的苏命如同死神般令人心颤。
“你……你要做什么？”看着一步步走来的苏命，柳媚儿面露惊恐，不断后退。
后脚跟踢到一阶台阶，柳媚儿摔倒在地。
看着越来越近的苏命，柳媚儿摇头如拨浪鼓：“我是柳家的人，还是苏家的夫人，你……你不能杀我，你要是杀了我，苏家和柳家都不会放过你的。”
“是吗？”苏命冷冷道：“那你要杀我的时候，可曾想过这些？”
“我……”柳媚儿哑口无言，身体剧烈地颤抖。
content_en:
Chapter 13: Clan elder Su Ran shouted softly, and Su Ming swung his sword fiercely.
In an instant, nine golden sword lights slashed out one after another.
"Martial skills! How can you know martial arts?" Seeing this scene, Liu Tianran looked surprised.
In Qianlong City, martial arts can be said to be extremely precious. Even members of the four major families in Qianlong City are not qualified to experience martial arts before they reach the Qi Sea Realm.
Su Ming has been a waste for so many years, but he has mastered martial arts once he wakes up. This is really unbelievable.
"You don't need to know the answer anymore." As Su Ming spoke, the sword light had already struck in front of Liu Tianran.
"Just you?" Liu Tianran sneered and struck the sword light with his knife, blocking the sword light's attack.
But before he had time to breathe, the next moment the second sword light had already struck.
Then, there is the third sword light...
The fourth sword light...
The fifth sword light...
…
The sword light was like waves in the sea, striking towards Liu Tianran one after another.
The nine sword rays released huge sword energy power. Liu Tianran resisted with all his strength, but the next moment, a shattering sound suddenly came from Liu Tianran's blade.
"Crack!"
A crack appeared on the blade, and then the crack became bigger and bigger, and the long knife shattered into pieces under Liu Tianran's disbelieving eyes.
"No! This...how is this possible!"
The long knife shattered, and under the huge impact, Liu Tianran flew backwards out of the courtyard gate like a cannonball, and then hit the ground heavily.
But Su Ming had no intention of letting Liu Tianran go just like that. He flashed and came to Liu Tianran with his sword in hand.
"You...what are you going to do?" Looking at Su Ming in front of him, Liu Tianran looked horrified.
He was originally sent by the Liu family to deal with Su Ming, but unexpectedly, he didn't even take a single blow from Su Ming.
"What are you doing?" Su Ming sneered repeatedly: "Of course I will kill you!"
"No..." Liu Tianran shook his head crazily. Faced with death, he finally showed fear.
Behind her, Liu Mei'er shouted: "Su Ming, Liu Tianran is the elder of my Liu family. If you dare to kill him, you will fight to the death with my Liu family!"
"Haha..." Su Ming smiled when he heard this, revealing his white teeth, which glowed coldly in the middle of the night.
"If I don't kill him, will the Liu family just laugh away their grudges with me? Stop saying such things that everyone finds funny!"
As soon as the words fell, Su Ming's long sword pierced Liu Tianran's chest hard under the surprised gazes of Liu Mei'er and Liu Tianran.
"Poof!"
The sword easily penetrated Liu Tianran's chest, and the latter's eyes widened, as if he could not believe that Su Ming really dared to attack him.
"Whoosh!"
Pulling out his long sword, Su Ming didn't even glance at the lifeless Liu Tianran behind him.
He held a bloody sword and walked towards Liu Meier step by step.
Blood flowed down the long sword to the ground, and Su Ming at this moment was as trembling as the god of death.
"You...what are you going to do?" Looking at Su Ming walking step by step, Liu Meier looked frightened and kept backing away.
Kicking her heels to the first step, Liu Meier fell to the ground.
Looking at Su Ming getting closer and closer, Liu Mei'er shook her head like a rattle: "I am a member of the Liu family and the wife of the Su family. You... you can't kill me. If you kill me, neither the Su family nor the Liu family will let you go."
"Really?" Su Ming said coldly: "Then when you wanted to kill me, did you ever think about this?"
"I..." Liu Meier was speechless, her body trembling violently.
